how_to_reach: Well-connected via Balkampet Road, Sanjeeva Reddy Nagar Road, and Ameerpet Road.
Nearest bus stop is Balkampet Bus Stop, located approximately 100 meters from the temple.
Nearest metro stations are SR Nagar Metro Station (Red Line, ~400m-500m) and Ameerpet Metro Station (Red/Blue Line interchange, ~1.5km-2.0km).
Nearest MMTS station is Nature Cure Hospital MMTS Station (~1.5 km); nearest major railway station is Secunderabad Railway Station (SC, ~8km-9km).
Nearest airport is Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (HYD, ~35km-40km).

nearest_railway_station.name: Nature Cure Hospital MMTS Station / Secunderabad Railway Station (SC)
nearest_railway_station.distance: Nature Cure Hospital MMTS: ~1.5 km; Secunderabad Railway Station: ~8 km to 9 km
nearest_railway_station.connectivity: Secunderabad Railway Station connects major cities. Devotees can hire auto-rickshaws or take public transport from there.

parking_info: A dedicated multi-level parking complex has been developed near the Balkampet Yellamma temple to manage visitor vehicles, offering a more streamlined alternative to previous street-parking arrangements.
Severe traffic congestion occurs on Sundays, Tuesdays, and during the Bonalu festival, often prompting police to implement one-way traffic rules on Balkampet Road.
